testSmells.title: Improper Organization
testSmells.message:
It does not have a Proper Organization.

Tests should have the following structure:

- Arrange: This is where you initialize objects and set the value of the data to be passed to the function under test.

- Act: The act section invokes the function under test.

- Assert: This is where you verify that the action of the function under test behaves as expected.

So asserts should be together at the end of the test.

mentorFindings.name: No class-name prefix in names
mentorFindings.title: No class-name prefix in names: CrawlerFacing class>>facing:
mentorFindings.detail: The selector CrawlerFacing class>>facing: repeats a word of the class name. A message name is read in the context of its receiver's class, so drop the class-name prefix.

mentorFindings.name: Avoid setters
mentorFindings.title: Avoid setters: SurveyCrawler>>faceTowards:
mentorFindings.detail: The method SurveyCrawler>>faceTowards: does not follow the heuristic: Setters break immutability; when state must change, copy it from an already valid instance with syncWith:.

mentorFindings.name: Move helper method to the right class
mentorFindings.title: Move helper method to the right class: SurveyCrawler>>hasRepetitionDigitIn:
mentorFindings.detail: The method SurveyCrawler>>hasRepetitionDigitIn: does not follow the heuristic: A method referencing no self, super nor instance variable is a helper: it belongs on the class of one of its parameters, as an extension method when that class is in another package.
